svg.title: Five-channel driver · existing 35 × 15 mm proposal — bottom worksheet
svg.text: 35 × 15 mm proposed isolated-pad layout · 2.54 mm pitch · not to scale for drilling
SOLDER SIDE — mirror view; A1 right; same physical hole names
EXTERNAL WIRE TERMINALS · square marks on the board
C3: ESP GPIO6 / S3: ESP GPIO4
C3: ESP GPIO7 / S3: ESP GPIO6
C3: ESP GPIO20 / S3: ESP GPIO11
CONNECTIONS · one row per physical conductor
Taps: C2 / C4 / C6 / C8 / C10 / C13
LEG = existing component leg, bare silver line. WIRE/BUS = added
insulated conductor. Filled dots are deliberate solder joints,
including intermediate pads. White gaps at other pads do not join.
Solder every hole listed for each retained leg and bus.
Identify actual E/B/C or D/G/S roles first; package outlines
do not specify pin order. Leave retained legs untrimmed until
their joints are complete. Insulate crossings that are not
Only listed solder joints connect. Blank-board pads are separate. OUT− is system ground; BAT− stays separate.
